title: Index postings build in linear time
summary: Graph index postings (byName, byDiscriminator, byKind, bySystem, byCategory, byLane, byArtifactSet, selectors and conditions) now check membership with a set beside each list instead of scanning the list on every insert. Building a bucket of n identities was quadratic: loading 20,000 records of one word took 9 s and now takes about 1.2 s. The lists, their order and the serialized graph are unchanged.
